title: Seed Scripts
description: Write and run seed scripts to populate your database with initial data for development and testing.

data.text: Seed scripts populate your database with initial data. Prisma supports seeding via the `prisma db seed` command and a `seed` property in `schema.prisma`.

data.title: Seed Configuration
data.content: Configure the seed script in schema.prisma.

data.title: Seed Script
data.content: Create a seed script that creates initial users and posts.
